import json,hashlib,pathlib
rd=pathlib.Path('migration-package/runs/round13')

for k in ('answer','spec','record'):
    r=st.get(k) or {}; p=r.get('path'); w=r.get('sha256')
    if not p: continue
    f=pathlib.Path('migration-package')/p
    g=hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if f.exists() else 'MISSING'
    print(k, 'OK' if g==w else 'MISMATCH')
